properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 8 sites are ssh/scp invocations with -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no and/or UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null in cluster ops scripts (net/): host-key verification disabled, defeating TOFU and enabling active MITM on node admin channels. Changeable here: drop the flags and pin known host keys.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sha1 crate resolved in the workspace lockfile as a transitive dependency; no workspace source calls SHA-1 (the only 'sha1' strings in code are version-crate comments about git commit-hash labels). SHA-1 is cryptographically broken for collisions (classical) — available in the shipped dependency tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: libsecp256k1 = "0.6.0" at workspace root Cargo.toml:242, consumed by accounts-db and others; Solana's secp256k1 verify/recover syscalls and secp256k1 builtin program (cost-model carries SECP256K1_VERIFY_COST and the program id). Quantum-vulnerable ECDSA (secp256k1) used for transaction signature recovery; migration target ML-DSA. Sampled sites: dependency declarations, program-id references, cost constants — all genuine.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: 70 sites of ==/!= comparisons over digest-typed values: account/bank hashes for integrity checks (accounts_db.rs), consensus data — genesis/block/slot hash comparisons (cli feature.rs, core banking_trace/consensus/optimistic_confirmation_verifier). These are public integrity digests, not secrets, so timing leakage is low-value; recorded as posture information. Rule class (digest compared in non-constant time) is legitimate to keep for downstream ranking.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSA implementation present in the docs website's npm dependency tree (node-forge modules resolved in docs/package-lock.json). Docs-site build asset, not validator runtime code; Shor-vulnerable RSA available in the shipped library.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ed25519-dalek =1.0.1 and ed25519-dalek-bip32 declared at Cargo.toml:197-198 and consumed workspace-wide (accounts-db, cli-output, sdk, perf, ledger): Ed25519 is Solana's primary signature scheme — transaction/vote/shred signing and verification, the ed25519 builtin program, and GPU/CPU sigverify paths. Shor-vulnerable signature scheme; migration target ML-DSA-65 or SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: curve25519-dalek = "3.2.1" at Cargo.toml:187, patched to Solana's own fork via [patch.crates-io.curve25519-dalek] git override (Cargo.toml:543-544) — Curve25519 arithmetic library (Ed25519 verification math via Edwards/Scalar in solana-perf/src/sigverify.rs:689, X25519 availability). Shor-vulnerable; X25519→ML-KEM-768 hybrid, Ed25519→ML-DSA. The git-fork patch is itself a supply-chain/governance artifact.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The remaining sites are ecdsa-sha2-nistp256 SSH authorized_keys entries in net/scripts/solana-user-authorized_keys.sh (lines 17-91, interleaved with ssh-ed25519 entries) — same deployed key material as object ALG-92e838c9. Shor-vulnerable SSH user-auth keys; ops-changeable. The two debug-string sites and the buildkite ssh-keygen site were adjudicated individually.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: 15 deployed SSH user-authentication keys (ecdsa-sha2-nistp256 over NIST P-256) installed for named users on all testnet/datacenter nodes via net/scripts/solana-user-authorized_keys.sh (header even prescribes ssh-keygen -t ecdsa). Shor-vulnerable ECDSA; migration: rotate to PQ-capable SSH auth (hybrid ML-KEM) when available; changeable by ops.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak256 (SHA-3 family) exposed to BPF programs via the sol_keccak256 syscall (Keccak256Hasher over keccak::Hasher, registered at programs/bpf_loader/src/syscalls/mod.rs:317) plus SHA-3/SHAKE sources in programs/sbf/c/src/sha. properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context

Misuse-resistant AEAD, 128-bit key; quantum-relevant via Grover; migration AES-256-GCM / future PQ AEAD.
